knowledge_base.title: Mid-Cycle Plan Upgrades
knowledge_base.content: If upgrading mid-cycle, agents must ask the customer to explicitly agree to the prorated charge. Resolution Code: UPGRADE_PRORATED_EXEC

knowledge_base.title: Integration Limits by Tier
knowledge_base.content: The Starter plan is strictly limited to 3 active integrations. If they attempt a 4th, advise them to disconnect one or upgrade. Resolution Code: PLAN_LIMIT_EXPLAINED

knowledge_base.title: Storage & Cross-Selling
knowledge_base.content: If usage >90% capacity, you MUST cross-sell the 'Deep Archive Add-on'. Resolution Code: CROSS_SELL_ARCHIVE_OFFERED

TCK-2001: Hi there! I absolutely love the platform, but I think I need more features. Can you help me out?
Oh, sorry! I'm looking to upgrade to the Pro plan. But I'm halfway through my billing month. How does that work?
Got it! Yes, please go ahead and process the upgrade for me. I agree to the prorated charge.
TCK-2002: Hello! Hope you're having a good day. I'm trying to connect my Slack, but it says I hit a limit?
I am currently on the 'Starter' plan, I believe.
Oh, I see. I'll just disconnect Zoom then. Thanks!
TCK-2004: Hey! I'm running out of storage space on my account. Is there a quick way to bulk delete my old 2024 project files?
Oh, I didn't know there was an Archive add-on. Will that let me keep the files without clogging up my active workspace?
That sounds perfect. Yes, please add the Deep Archive to my account instead of deleting everything.
